title: US fixed income closes early at 2:00 p.m. ET while equities run a full session — the inverse of a half day
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes); the 2027 US panel lives in the page's own RSC payload rather than the rendered 2026 tab, and its Christmas card reads verbatim 'Christmas Day | Friday, December 24, 2027 | Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Thursday, December 23, 2027'. The equity side is the same session's nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars fetch (HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes): NYSE's 2027 Christmas Day row reads 'Friday, December 24 (Christmas Day observed)' and carries NO early-close footnote — its three early-close footnotes cover only July 3 2028, the three day-after-Thanksgiving dates, and December 24 2026. So on 2027-12-23 the equity market runs 09:30-16:00 and SIFMA recommends bonds shut at 14:00. Filed estimate on the standing count: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for an exchange operator's or a trade association's own hours page, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep
notes: PROPOSED by the thanksgiving-half-day-2027-11-26 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-08), found in the same SIFMA 2027 panel that established this lane's own event's bond side. Schema follows the settled trading-hours precedent (thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27, good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26): kind 'sector', impact low, symbols [], estimate with a NEWS: source. WHY IT EARNS A ROW: it is the MIRROR of the half-day geometry this calendar already tracks. On a Thanksgiving or Christmas Eve half day, equities close at 13:00 and SIFMA keeps bonds open to 14:00, so the Treasury tape is the last US price discovery running. On 2027-12-23 the asymmetry reverses — bonds go dark at 14:00 and equities trade two more hours with no live Treasury reference, which is the state a cross-asset leg is least equipped for. This calendar has tracked the equity side of trading-hours events and never the bond-only side; that is a hole, not a decision, and no new kind is required to fill it. CAUTION ON THE INFERENCE: SIFMA publishes a RECOMMENDATION, not a rule, and 2027-12-23's equity hours are asserted from the ABSENCE of an NYSE early-close footnote rather than from a positive statement that the session is full-length. Both are why this is an estimate. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry; a lane researching this id should re-fetch both primaries and, if NYSE has since published a 2027-12-23 early close, amend rather than delete.
